products.name: HOOBS Box (HSLF-3)
products.summary: A pre-built Homebridge hub that runs the Ring plugin and shows Ring doorbells, cameras and Ring Alarm in the Apple Home app. HOOBS lists the Ring Video Doorbell Pro, Ring Alarm Security Kit, Stick Up Cam Elite and Floodlight Cam as tested accessories. Ring is not HomeKit-native, so this is a third-party workaround, not an official Ring feature.
products.renterNote: For an Apple Home renter who already has Ring and does not want to run a Raspberry Pi or server. Caveat: it must stay plugged in and online, uses Ring's cloud (live view can lag), and the standard Ring plugin does not give HomeKit Secure Video (Scrypted is the route the pages name for that).
pros: Pre-installed Homebridge; no server to build, per HOOBS and addtohomekit.com
Ring plugin exposes doorbell, cameras and Ring Alarm sensors to Apple Home per the sources
Doorbell presses can trigger HomeKit scenes and chime a HomePod per the sources
cons: Third-party and unofficial: Ring can change its cloud login and break the plugin
No HomeKit Secure Video through the standard Ring plugin; cloud-based live view is slower than native HomeKit cameras
products.scoreNote: No drilling and unplugs cleanly; setup is plugin and token work, and Ring support is unofficial, so compatibility is partial.
